summary: Pagination orders by created_at only, so posts sharing a timestamp are skipped or repeated across pages.

concerns.detail: Cursor must encode (created_at, id); the tie-break test fails.

evidence.claim: ORDER BY created_at DESC has no id tie-break

fixes_requested: Order by (created_at DESC, id DESC) and encode both in next_cursor.
Decode and apply both halves of the cursor in the WHERE clause.
